tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti/ mgon po'i mdos gtor 'phen rgyu 'di thog mar/ me glang lo'i zla 4tshes 15nyin 'phen pa yin bsam pa dang / de'i phyi lo sa stag nas lcags stag bar la 'phen dgos pa 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong gis gsung rtags la babs pas/ sngar tshul mu bzhin zla ba bzhi par 'char can 'dra mo byung / de nas rgyun du rang ma byung yang chog tshod 'dug mod/ de'i dpe cha lag len bcas ban tshang pa na rim la 'jag na 'phral phugs su dgos gal che rigs yin pa bcas/ rgyun tshugs 'di bzhin zla ba bzhi pa 'di sngags pa kha rul gyi zla ba zhes zor 'phen pa 'dzems dgos pas/ zla ba gzhan zhig la spo ba gnang na zhes rtsis pa'i 'phros byung bas/ rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa khyi lo 'di nas bzung ji srid bar/ hor zla gsum pa'i nyer drug nas gnam gang bar ram/ drug nas bcu'i bar la mgon mdos/ ril sgrub yod med khyad/ bzhi pa'i drug nas bcu gnyis bar ram/ nyer drug nas lnga pa'i tshes gnyis bar dam tshig bskang gso/ bzhi pa'i bcu bzhi bco lnga gang rung nas/ gsang 'dus char chen tshugs na gang sar 'grigs 'dra bsam pas/ de bzhin gyi bkod thor sa khyi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la dpal sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ mgon po'i mdos gtor 'phen rgyu/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
